focus: 站會先講你欠別人什麼
lead: 多數人的站會只講「我做了什麼、我需要什麼」，於是別人卡在你身上你卻最後一個知道。今天練的是先講你欠誰什麼、什麼時候還，再講自己的進度——這一個順序的調換，會讓整個房間對你的信任度完全不同。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Before my update — two things I owe people.
phrases.gl: 在我報進度之前，先講我欠人的兩件事（把別人的卡點放在自己的進度前面）
phrases.ex: Before my update — two things I owe people: the frozen evaluation set for perception, and the bracket sign-off for hardware.

phrases.en: You're unblocked as of this morning.
phrases.gl: 從今天早上起你已經解卡了（主動宣告交付完成，別讓人自己去猜）
phrases.ex: Ivy, the two hundred cut-in scenarios are exported in your format — you're unblocked as of this morning.

phrases.en: That's on me, and here's the new date.
phrases.gl: 這是我的問題，新的日期是……（認帳一句，然後立刻往前走）
phrases.ex: The evaluation set should have gone out Wednesday. That's on me, and here's the new date: tomorrow, nine a.m.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Sorry for the delay, I will do it as soon as possible”

phrases.en: Short week — four working days, so here's what I cut.
phrases.gl: 這週只有四個工作天，所以我砍了這些（把日曆現實攤開，取捨就變得合理）
phrases.ex: Short week — four working days, so here's what I cut: the sensor-coverage report slides to next Monday.

phrases.gl: 這件事就結案了（明確關掉議題，避免它每週殭屍般復活）
phrases.ex: The timestamp drift on the rear pair turned out to be a logging bug, and it's patched — consider that closed.

phrases.en: The number I'm watching this week is…
phrases.gl: 我這週只盯這一個數字（宣告單一指標，比列五個 KPI 有力）
phrases.ex: The number I'm watching this week is the rejection rate on the data-quality gate — it's at 22% and I want it under 5%.

phrases.en: I'll say yes to that if…
phrases.gl: 如果……我就答應（有條件的 yes，比含糊的答應可靠得多）
phrases.ex: I'll say yes to that if Kevin confirms the mounting tolerance today — otherwise I'd be signing off on something I haven't seen.
phrases.fix: 取代 “OK OK, I will try my best”

phrases.en: I need ten minutes from you today, not a meeting.
phrases.gl: 我今天只需要你十分鐘，不用開會（把要求縮到最小，對方很難拒絕）
phrases.ex: Kevin, I need ten minutes from you today, not a meeting — just walk me through the tolerance change.

phrases.en: Give me until end of day and I'll confirm either way.
phrases.gl: 給我到今天下班，行不行我都會回覆（承諾的是回覆，不是結果——這才守得住）
phrases.ex: I don't want to guess on the reorder. Give me until end of day and I'll confirm either way.

setup: Setup. Monday stand-up after a public holiday on Friday, so this is a four-day week. Three people are waiting on something from you: Alan's perception team still hasn't received the frozen evaluation set you promised last Wednesday, and it's blocking two of his engineers; Ivy's simulation team needed two hundred cut-in scenarios exported in their format, which you finished at seven this morning; and Kevin needs your sign-off on the redesigned camera mounting bracket before he can place the order, which closes Wednesday. Your own headline is ugly: the automatic data-quality gate rejected 22% of last week's bags because the two front cameras drift about 35 milliseconds apart, and nobody has found the cause yet. David runs the stand-up and hates finding out about dependencies second-hand.

prompts.frame: What you owe, with dates → what you've delivered → your one real problem, with a number → the single thing you're watching this week.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 55 秒）。強迫自己第一句就講「我欠人的東西」，不要從自己的進度開始。
prompts.model: “Before my update — two things I owe people. Alan, the frozen evaluation set should have gone to you Wednesday and it didn't. That's on me, and here's the new date: nine a.m. tomorrow, and I'll send it straight to your two engineers rather than through the shared drive so nobody waits on me twice. Kevin, your bracket sign-off is the other one, and I know the order closes Wednesday — I'll come back to that in a second. On the good side, Ivy, the two hundred cut-in scenarios are exported in your format, so you're unblocked as of this morning. My own problem is the data-quality gate: it rejected 22% of last week's bags because the two front cameras are drifting about 35 milliseconds apart. We don't know the cause yet. Short week — four working days, so here's what I cut: the sensor-coverage report slides to next Monday. The number I'm watching this week is that rejection rate, and I want it under 5% by Friday.”

prompts.q: Alan, visibly annoyed: “I've been waiting on that evaluation set since Wednesday. Two of my people have had nothing to do for three days.”
prompts.frame: Own it in one sentence, no grovelling → say what actually happened, briefly → give the new commitment → say what you're changing so it doesn't repeat.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「認帳但不塌陷」——只道歉一次，然後把話題轉到補救和防呆上。
prompts.model: “You're right, and that's on me. What happened is I held it back because the gate was rejecting bags and I didn't want to hand you a set with holes in it — but I should have sent you the clean subset on Wednesday and flagged the gap, instead of sitting on all of it. You'll have the clean subset at nine tomorrow, and that's about 80% of what you asked for. For the missing 20%, can your two take the regression suite this week so they're not idle? And I'm changing one thing on my side: if I'm going to miss a handover date, you'll hear it from me the day before, not the day after.”

prompts.q: Kevin: “I need your sign-off on the bracket today. If it misses Wednesday's order window, the next batch is two weeks out.”
prompts.frame: Don't give a soft yes → name the one thing standing between you and yes → make the smallest possible ask → commit to a reply time, not an outcome.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「有條件的答應」——禁止用 “OK, I will try my best” 這種聽起來像答應、其實什麼都沒承諾的句子。
prompts.model: “I hear the deadline, and I don't want to be the reason it slips. But I'm not signing today on the version I've seen, because the mounting tolerance changed after the last review and I haven't seen the new numbers against our calibration range. So — I'll say yes to that if the tolerance still fits inside plus or minus two millimetres. Kevin, I need ten minutes from you today, not a meeting; just walk me through what changed. Give me until end of day and I'll confirm either way — and if the answer is no, you'll know today rather than Wednesday morning, so you've still got time to work around me.”

fixes.bad: The timestamp gap is more bigger than last week.
fixes.good: The timestamp gap is bigger than it was last week.
fixes.note: Comparatives（比較級）：bigger 已經是比較級，前面不能再加 more。要加強語氣就用 much bigger、significantly bigger。同理沒有 more better、more easier。

fixes.bad: We need to open a meeting with hardware team to solve this problem.
fixes.good: We should set up a quick call with hardware to sort this out.
fixes.note: Collocation（搭配詞）：中文的「開會」不是 open a meeting，英文是 have / set up / schedule a meeting。另外 solve a problem 沒錯，但口語會議裡 sort this out 更自然。

fixes.bad: I will try my best to send the evaluation set on Tuesday.
fixes.good: You'll have the evaluation set by nine on Tuesday. If that changes, I'll tell you Monday afternoon.
fixes.note: Register（承諾強度）：try my best 在英文職場等於「我沒有承諾」。要嘛給明確時間，要嘛明講不確定並承諾何時回覆——中間地帶只會讓人不信任你。

fixes.bad: This rejection is caused by we didn't align the two front cameras.
fixes.good: The rejections happen because we didn't align the two front cameras.
fixes.note: Grammar（子句結構）：caused by 後面只能接名詞或動名詞，不能接一個完整句子。要接句子就用 because；要用 caused by 就改成 caused by a misalignment between the two front cameras。

fixes.bad: I will notice you when the export is finished.
fixes.good: I'll let you know when the export is finished.
fixes.note: Word choice（用字）：notice 是「注意到」，不是「通知」。通知別人用 let you know（口語）或 notify you（正式書面）——這個錯誤在英文會議上特別容易被聽見。

challenge:
今天在真實 stand-up 中做這一件事：把「我欠誰什麼」放在自己的進度前面 ——

“Before my update — ___ things I owe people. ___, that's on me, and here's the new date: ___. ___, you're unblocked as of this morning.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文講一次你這週真實的狀況，順序刻意反過來。

  • 前 15 秒只能講你欠別人的東西，不能講自己的進度
  • 如果有東西遲交，只道歉一次，然後接 “That's on me, and here's the new date: ___.”
  • 明確關掉一件事：“Consider that closed.”
  • 結尾宣告本週唯一指標：“The number I'm watching this week is ___.”
  • 禁用：try my best、notice you、more bigger、open a meeting、as soon as possible
check: 我今天有沒有在講自己進度之前，先講出至少一件「別人正在等我」的事？
遲交的時候，我是道歉一次就給新日期，還是一直在解釋為什麼？
我這週有沒有一個明確、單一、可追蹤的數字，而不是五件同樣重要的事？
